description: This file defines a builder class for creating instances of JsonParseOptions, specifically for configuring URL decoding options in JSON parsing within the Demit Java project.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonParseOptionsBuilder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing JsonParseOptions with configurable URL decoding behavior.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with default settings (URL decoding disabled).

methods.name: withUrlDecoding
methods.description: Enables URL decoding in the resulting JsonParseOptions.

methods.name: withoutUrlDecoding
methods.description: Disables URL decoding in the resulting JsonParseOptions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable JsonParseOptions object configured as specified.
